description:
Implement the core format adapter system with registry and trait definition. Foundation for multi-format document support (Markdown, AsciiDoc, reStructuredText, MDX).

## Rationale

Documents come in many formats, not just Markdown. A pluggable adapter system allows jit to handle multiple formats while keeping format-specific logic isolated.

## Acceptance Criteria

### 1. Define DocFormatAdapter Trait

Create crates/jit/src/document/adapter.rs with trait for format adapters.

Trait methods:
- id() - adapter identifier (e.g., "markdown", "asciidoc")
- supports_path() - check file extension
- detect() - content-based format detection
- scan_assets() - extract asset references from content
- rewrite_links() - update links when docs/assets move

### 2. Implement AdapterRegistry

Registry to manage and resolve format adapters:
- Register built-in adapters
- Resolve adapter for path + content
- Extension match first, then content detection

### 3. Implement Markdown Adapter

Basic Markdown adapter with:
- Extension detection: .md, .markdown
- Image syntax patterns
- Link syntax patterns
- Support relative and root-relative paths
- Extract unique asset paths

### 4. Unit Tests

- Trait implementation tests
- Registry registration and resolution
- Markdown adapter asset extraction with various syntaxes
- Edge cases: malformed syntax, external URLs, anchors

### 5. Documentation

- Rustdoc for trait and registry
- Examples showing adapter usage
- How to add new format adapters

## Out of Scope (Phase 2+)

- Link rewriting implementation (stub for now)
- AsciiDoc, reStructuredText, MDX adapters
- Configuration-based adapter enable/disable

## Success Metrics

- Trait and registry implemented with full rustdoc
- Markdown adapter functional
- 100% test coverage for adapter logic
- clippy, fmt pass
title: Implement format adapter registry
